method: Site-design and volume-credit values (rooftop disconnection, tree credits, soil amendment and the runoff-reduction credit each manual gives each practice) read by hand from every atlas manual with its own rules. Candidate sentences were found by text search and each was read and judged: is it this rule, stated as a requirement (ok) or as a recommendation or typical range (typical)? Credit percentages are recorded as the manual states them; some manuals credit a share of the storage volume provided and others a share of the runoff entering the practice. Statistics count one value per state (the median of that state's manuals).
